Import a dated Raspberry Pi OS Lite Bookworm image.

## Configurations

Architecture-specific configurations replace the default configuration. The
default is used when no matching architecture override exists.

### arm64

| Setting    | Value                                                                                                                                   |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Import URL | https://downloads.raspberrypi.com/raspios_lite_arm64/images/raspios_lite_arm64-2024-03-15/2024-03-15-raspios-bookworm-arm64-lite.img.xz |

### armhf

| Setting    | Value                                                                                                                                   |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Import URL | https://downloads.raspberrypi.com/raspios_lite_armhf/images/raspios_lite_armhf-2024-03-15/2024-03-15-raspios-bookworm-armhf-lite.img.xz |

## Behavior

Imports the configured Raspberry Pi OS Lite image for arm64 or armhf. The source
URLs pin dated images rather than following the newest release. Add
core/rpi-raspios-setup when adapting the imported system for Rugix.

## Example

For example, choose this base for a project layer:

```toml
parent = "core/raspios-bookworm"
```
